name: Hornero Uptime
description: Uptime 2.0: bar indicator plus popover/dashboard session detail (uptime, boot time, idle time) from /proc/uptime with the declared cat command. No PluginKit uptime facade exists; error state instead of a fabricated zero.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Battery & Uptime 2.0 (#31): activation popover and dashboard card with uptime, derived boot time and /proc/uptime idle time, refresh on activation, typed refresh setting (60s 1.x default), host-context layout and Spanish catalog. PluginKit exposes no uptime member, so the declared cat /proc/uptime read is kept.
Bar widget showing system uptime from /proc/uptime every 60 seconds; error state when unreadable.

refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between /proc/uptime reads (the 1.x fixed 60-second cadence by default).

showLabel.description: Prefix the bar value with 'Up' (the 1.x behaviour); off shows the duration alone.

showWhenUnavailable.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled unavailable, when /proc/uptime cannot be read (the 1.x behaviour); off hides it until a read succeeds.
